newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Runaway BTPs to head to 138.40.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Runaway BTPs to head to 138.40.

text.p: September BTP futures are back in the fast lane and have an easy ride forward to about 138.40 on Thursday, and 139.30 in the coming two-three sessions, technical analysts said.
Hans Guenter Redeker, senior economist at Chase in London, said the runaway Italian market was underpinned by plenty of support between 137.90 and 137.65, the top traded on Tuesday.
"The market looks pretty bullish here," said Redeker, pegging resistance at 138.22 initially, followed by 138.44.
By 0800 GMT, September BTP futures stood 14 basis points down on the day at 137.90.
